description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, a filter implementing the LogNode interface that filters log output to only pass messages without metadata or metadata.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class implementing LogNode that filters out all log metadata, passing only message text.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode for chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters log entries to pass only the message part to the next LogNode, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
